race.comment: ELASTANE MISS (1) got a long way off them when resuming. She won't need to do that from this barrier. Her best runs have come when second up as well. Goes on top in a race that is very winnable. BABUSHKA'S PRIDE (7) won her only start at this track. Her best effort did arrive when leading so will they head forward first up? TULLY'S BELL (10) did a nice job three weeks ago. That was so much better than her first up outing. CALAIS BLISS (2) is another that can run well here. Looks the right race without great depth about.
